data_fields.name: auto_neighbour_exits
data_fields.donor_constant: on by default; off with /one or /two

data_fields.name: legend_key_length
data_fields.donor_constant: intended one character (donor example keys are tuples, which never match)

data_fields.name: minimap_room_step
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 slots per compass step, 1 slot connector

best_idea: A zone's layout can be a short text grid with one character per tile, a legend from each character to a builder, one row-order scan that creates the tiles, a second scan that wires connections between tiles that already exist, and automatic two-way N/E/S/W links.
decision_why: Zones as data: the text grid is readable in review and the create-then-wire order fits zone builds. The donor's tuple legend keys are broken, so keys must be validated at load, and its one-object-per-room model does not fit a server-side typed array.
acceptance: A town zone is authored as a text grid; a server test refuses a legend key longer than one character at load and asserts a road tile on the grid edge makes no exit and does not crash; the client minimap shows only rooms the player can traverse.
